name: Shadowdancer
theme: Apotheosis of the Predator. First hit always Marks, every Marked hit feeds Shadow Momentum, the encounter ends before it starts.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Mark applies on first hit regardless of skill. Hits on marked targets generate Shadow Momentum.'
Pairs with assassin.json shadowdancer path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Untouchable + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Mark Hunter.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 6 of 8 nodes wireable today (stat:critChance / stat:cooldownRecovery / stat:ailmentDuration / whileTag(mark) damageMult / procOnCrit applyTag(mark)). First-hit-Mark + Mark-hit-generates-Momentum capstone needs Phase F.

nodes.name: Stalker's Eye
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% crit chance (foundation — Marks become more reliable).

nodes.name: Phantom Step
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% cooldown recovery (foundation pacing — pairs with Shadow Momentum).

nodes.name: Killer's Grace
nodes.description: +0.5/1.0/1.5s ailment duration (broadens Shadow Mark windows via the ailment-duration channel).

nodes.name: Mark Stalker
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% damage to Marked targets (foundation Mark vulnerability scaler).

nodes.name: Shadow Reach
nodes.description: On crit, +10/20/30% chance to apply Mark to the target (cross-skill Mark applier).

nodes.name: Twin Marks
nodes.description: Mark application reaches one additional enemy in encounter (chained from primary target).

nodes.name: Mark Hunter
nodes.description: +10/20/30% damage to Marked targets (stacks with Mark Stalker for deeper Marked-vulnerability scaling).

nodes.name: Untouchable
nodes.description: Mark applies on first hit regardless of skill (no crit required). Hits on Marked targets generate Shadow Momentum (cooldowns start 2s earlier). The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
